title: Every scheduler turn scans all parked tasks, and every finished child scans its siblings.
text: From the Stage 4 review, not re-run: `run()` (`crates/nvs-host/src/scheduler.rs:977`) collects `doomed` by iterating the whole `parked` map, and `run_until_idle` (`reactor.rs:858`) calls it on every reactor wake, so a turn is O(parked tasks). `retire` (`scheduler.rs:422`) and `detach` (`:442`) run `parent.children.retain` per child, O(siblings) each and O(n²) for a fan-out of n; `children_of` (`:1148`) clones the list per call. `Drop for Waiter` (`crates/nvs-host/src/channel.rs:183`) is a `position` over the side's queue that normally finds nothing, O(n²) to drain n waiters. Not checked: whether `self.finished` (`scheduler.rs:953`) is drained under `nvs serve`. Ladders: `scheduler/parked.nvs` (N idle tasks beside one busy loop) and `scheduler/fan-out.nvs` (N children that all finish); both should be flat per task.
